title: Clickety Cuttlefish
statement: Amidst softly swaying emerald kelp and warm, amber-lit driftwood, this thumb-sized cephalopod ripples with pastel light patterns while tidily arranging tumbled sea glass into neat spirals. If you linger quietly by the glass, you can hear a faint, rhythmic click-clack as it taps each pebble to test for the perfect fit.
